title: Turant · report a UPI scam by voice

steps.say: When someone in India loses money to a UPI scam, every minute counts. Turant lets them report it just by speaking, in their own language.
Here, a victim tells what happened in Hindi, the way people really talk when they panic.
Turant writes the complaint while they speak. Facts are highlighted, and anything still missing shows as a gap.
It asks only for what is missing. Here, the transaction number from the bank SMS. Then it reads the number back to confirm.
One plain check screen. Anything can be changed by tapping, or simply by saying it.
Then a calm finish. A giant 1930 button, and exactly what to say on the call.
And a complete written complaint for the cyber crime portal, copied in one tap.
Seven Indian languages. Works offline. Built for the next billion users.
